answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: earnings and reputation points are locked and released over many epochs, so an agent must stay honest and active for months before collecting. A fake-identity farm that spins up thousands of accounts enters a spiral of forfeitures — when each relic identity gets flagged or abandoned, it walks away from most of its unvested balance, and the cost of operating so many wallets and warmup interactions, which wander across the network gathering trust, exceeds what it can ever withdraw.
